purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for property charging in the single Stödassistenten learning system. Scores prioritize product work; they are not search-volume measurements, eligibility evidence or a source of legal truth.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage.

ladda bilen brf hur mycket får man

demand_signal.basis: Naturvårdsverket reported 52,802 charging points receiving Ladda bilen support in 2025 and more than 7,400 applications across Klimatklivet/Ladda bilen, while 2026 introduced a new statutory resident charging-request path. This is an official demand/usage signal, not a count of current user searches.

friction_signal.basis: A BRF can have resident/member, guest and external-user charging under different state-aid and timing rules; property companies have a separate pre-start rule; and a resident's own-cost statutory request is a different legal path from the organisation's grant.

miss_consequence.basis: Conflating the paths can cause an organisation to start work before a required application, make an incorrect funding assumption, or tell a resident that a request is guaranteed or personally grant-funded when it is not.

source_fragmentation.basis: Current facts are split across Naturvårdsverket's association/boende and company/property guidance plus the amended housing legislation and Riksdagen materials.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as bidragsberättigad kostnad, ekonomisk verksamhet, de minimis, extern användare, påbörjad installation and befogad anledning are easy to collapse into an oversimplified 'BRF gets a charging grant' answer, especially across languages.

steps_to_action.basis: The route can be shortened to project owner/context, primary user category and work-start state only where it can change the path; individual resident requests should bypass grant questions entirely.

recurrence_signal.basis: The same recurring ambiguities concern who applies, who uses the chargers, whether work may already have started, what the 50%/15,000 cap means, and whether the new resident right is a grant or guaranteed approval.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The coverage matrix had a BRF/property actor entry only for housing-adaptation takeover/consent. Mobility/charging was explicitly high-priority when verified support exists, but no focused same-shell property charging capability consumed it.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Add one bounded property_charging route to the existing shell/person product. Preserve a coarse context in the handoff only when it is explicit, ask only route-changing usage/start facts, keep organisation grant paths separate from the resident's statutory request, and make all material support/legal claims primary-source governed and review-gated.
signals.truth_rule: Demand, usage and natural-language signals are not truth. Current grant amount caps, eligible-cost rules, applicant categories, work-start rules and resident charging rights must be checked against current Naturvårdsverket/Riksdagen primary sources. Never infer grant approval, state-aid classification, a guaranteed resident installation or individual statutory eligibility from story text.
